::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Chennai firm founded in May 2021 by CEO Hiram Prasanna Samuel. Mainly a spec-to-GDSII engineering-services house (RTL to physical design, analog layout, test chips), and it claims '10+ first-silicon successes', presumably on client projects. Lists its own edge-AI audio processor products (STRU-SVP-01-ES, STRU-ACP-01-ES, STRU-AP-01-ES) with no public specs or silicon status. No outside funding reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Audio processing chips plus design services for clients.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 3/5:** Domain difficulty 3: audio DSP/edge-AI processors with analog front ends; moderate complexity.
- **IP ownership 3/5:** IP ownership 3: own audio products claimed; architecture and licensed-core content undisclosed.
- **Design completeness 2/5:** Design completeness 2: three named audio parts ('-ES' suffix) but no tape-out or silicon reported.
- **Market readiness 1/5:** Market readiness 1: no samples or customers for own chips; first-silicon claims relate to services.
